definitions.gloss: presentation; formal oral or visual presentation
definitions.explanation: A formal presentation of information, proposals, or ideas, typically to an audience. Usually involves slides, visuals, or structured speaking. Commonly abbreviated to プレゼン in everyday use.

examples.japanese: プレゼンテーションの{準備|じゅんび}をする。
プレゼンテーションがうまくいって{安堵|あんど}した。
examples.english: I was relieved that the presentation went well.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}では{新|あたら}しいプロジェクトについてプレゼンテーションを{行|おこな}い、{参加者|さんかしゃ}から{多|おお}くの{質問|しつもん}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: At the meeting, I gave a presentation on the new project and received many questions from the participants.

notes:
Loanword from English 'presentation'. Commonly shortened to プレゼン in informal speech and writing. The full form プレゼンテーション is used in more formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プレゼンテーションをする／{行|おこな}う: to give a presentation
- プレゼンテーションの{準備|じゅんび}: presentation preparation
- プレゼンテーション{資料|しりょう}: presentation materials/slides
- プレゼンテーションスキル: presentation skills

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プレゼン: the common informal abbreviation; interchangeable in most contexts
- {発表|はっぴょう}: announcement, presentation — broader term covering academic or public presentations, reports, and announcements
